## FEDERAL BANK LTD (FEDERALBNK) - HOLD

**RECOMMENDATION SUMMARY**

We maintain a HOLD rating on Federal Bank with a target price of ₹285, implying 2.6% downside from current levels of ₹292.60. The stock is fairly valued, reflecting strong operational improvements but limited near-term upside given recent re-rating.

**INVESTMENT CASE**

• **Asset quality at cyclical lows with improving trajectory**: GNPA at 1.72% and NNPA at 0.42% represent decadal-best levels, while provision coverage of 75.14% provides adequate buffer. Management's revised FY26 credit cost guidance of 52-53 bps (down from 55-60 bps) reflects stabilizing MFI portfolio and improving underwriting discipline.

• **NIM expansion runway remains intact**: Management explicitly states margin improvement is "a journey not yet complete," driven by structural CASA improvement (44.4%, up 106 bps QoQ) and shift toward medium-yield assets. While Q4 FY26 will absorb two-thirds impact of recent rate cut, the 3.18% NIM has room to expand over multiple quarters given industry-leading liability franchise transformation.

• **Strategic Blackstone partnership de-risks growth**: The Blackstone investment (post-CCI approval) strengthens capital adequacy (currently 15.20%) and provides access to global institutional expertise, positioning Federal Bank for sustained mid-teens loan growth without equity dilution concerns.

• **Operating leverage emerging**: Company delivered 21.4% profit CAGR over five years with cost-to-income improving to 53.92%. Record fee income of ₹896 crores and highest-ever operating profit of ₹1,729 crores demonstrate scalability, though deposit growth (15%) outpacing loan growth (9%) suggests cautious underwriting in current cycle.

**KEY RISKS**

• **Margin compression from rate cuts**: While management guides for continued NIM expansion, two-thirds of recent rate cut impact will materialize in Q4 FY26. Further rate cuts could pressure margins faster than CASA accretion can offset, particularly given aggressive liability repricing competition.

• **MFI portfolio remains vulnerable**: Despite sequential improvement, management maintains selective growth stance "for one more quarter," suggesting incomplete stabilization. Industry-wide MFI stress could resurface if rural consumption weakens.

• **Elevated contingent liabilities**: At ₹2,17,515 crores, contingent liabilities present tail risk, while low interest coverage ratio and potential interest capitalization practices warrant monitoring for balance sheet quality.

**VALUATION**

At 1.6x FY26E P/B (implied by current market cap of ₹71,964 crores), Federal Bank trades at slight premium to its historical mean but below best-in-class private banks. ROE of 11.68% and ROA of 1.15% remain below peer averages, limiting valuation multiple expansion. Our ₹285 target reflects 1.55x FY26E P/B, factoring in improved asset quality and margin trajectory but discounting execution risks in accelerating growth. Recommend accumulating below ₹275 or on 10%+ correction.
